title: BOEING_2022_10K — Note 4, net deferred tax assets and three-year cumulative loss position (p78)
key_points: The valuation allowance balance rose from $2,423 million at December 31, 2021 to $3,162 million at December 31, 2022.

Deferred tax assets were $12,301 million (2022) vs $11,258 million (2021); deferred tax liabilities were $(9,306) million vs $(8,976) million; net deferred tax assets after valuation allowance were $(167) million vs $(141) million.
Boeing states it was in a three-year cumulative pre-tax loss position in the fourth quarter of 2020 and throughout 2021 and 2022.
Boeing warns that until it generates sustained levels of profitability, additional valuation allowances may have to be recorded with corresponding adverse impacts on earnings and/or OCI.
Boeing generated tax NOL in 2021 and interest carryovers in 2021 and 2022 that can be carried forward indefinitely, plus federal R&D credits that can be carried forward 20 years.
